name: shell
need: Frame an app: top bar, navigation drawer, content panel, account and banners

--ds-drawer-item-height.description: drawer item at size md and comfortable (8px per size step, 4px per density step; its rest radius is half of what it computes to, so the press morph runs its whole way)

--ds-topbar-scrolled-bg.description: top bar while the view is scrolled (`data-scrolled`); `transparent` keeps a flat bar

--ds-view-scrollbar-gutter.description: the view's scrollbar gutter: `stable both-edges` (symmetric) or `auto` (no reserved room)

--ds-segmented-padding-x.description: the inline padding of a segmented option (narrow switches)

--ds-account-text-max.description: the name and email beside the avatar in `.ds-account--capsule`

--ds-avatar-size.description: `.ds-avatar` and the account's avatar at size md (8px per size step)

--ds-drawer-font.description: the type of a drawer item (always at the regular weight; the current item takes the label weight) and of a group toggle (in the label weight)

--ds-drawer-indent.description: one level of a nested drawer group

--ds-segmented-height.description: the segmented track at size md and comfortable (8px per size step, 4px per density step)

--ds-segmented-font.description: the type of a segmented option (always at the regular weight; the current option takes the label weight)

hover..ds-drawer__list:hover: shows the scrollbar of a scrolling drawer list, no choreography

ripple..ds-brand: the home link in the top bar: identity, not a control; no state layer, ripple or morph (like a link in text)
ripple..ds-skip: a keyboard-only skip link, shown only while focused: its focus ring is the feedback

physical..ds-app--drawer .ds-panel: margin-left: clears the safe-area margin-left of the panel, which stays physical
physical..ds-drawer: left: the modal drawer slides in from the left edge
physical..ds-drawer: border-radius: the modal drawer slides in from the left edge: its open side is the right
physical..ds-drawer::before: right: the bleed left of the modal drawer covers the slide's overshoot

focus..ds-skip: the skip link is shown only while focused
